summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AfghanFood.de - German Afghan food platform. Backend APIs working excellently (95.5% success rate), frontend fully functional with all navigation, recipes, admin features working correctly.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns HTTP 200 instead of 201 for recipe creation
minor_bugs.impact: Cosmetic - functionality works correctly, just wrong status code

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section and recipe preview (4 recipes shown)
Navigation works to all pages (Rezepte, Blog, Esskultur)
Recipes page shows all 3 expected recipes (Qabuli Palaw, Mantu, Bolani)
Recipe detail pages load with ingredients and preparation steps
Blog page loads (1 blog post found)
All static pages load correctly (Afghanische Esskultur, Über uns, Impressum, Datenschutz)
Admin login works with correct credentials (admin@afghanfood.de / Admin123!)
Admin dashboard shows recipes list after login (4 recipes in table)
Admin recipe management (New Recipe button, form opens/closes)
All backend endpoints functional (21/22 tests passed)
Static page content loading from API
Recipe CRUD operations functional for admin users
